name: Italia Coast to Coast
description_md:
The Italia Coast to Coast is a waymarked hiking route in Italy. This national network trail covers 410.9 km and is signposted as C2C.

The route involves 10291 m of ascent and 10291 m of descent. It is classified as hard due to the distance and ascent, requiring about 130 hours of walking time under the DIN 33466 rule. The path passes within 100 m of Assisi and the Basilica superiore di San Francesco d'Assisi. It also passes within 1800 m of the Porziuncola.
